name: Twigpine Wrap Hook
mechanic: 1:1 wrapper hook for TWIG (Twigpine), the ERC20Wrapper of GITLAWB on Base
plain:
1:1 wrapper hook for TWIG (Twigpine), the ERC20Wrapper of GITLAWB on Base. Swaps on the TWIG/GITLAWB pool (fee 0, tick spacing 1) are filled by wrapping GITLAWB into TWIG or unwrapping TWIG into GITLAWB at exactly 1:1, with no fee. Same design as Uniswap's WETH hook, built on a byte-identical copy of BaseTokenWrapperHook from Uniswap's v4-hooks-public (commit e4eabe5).

Flags: beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity (adding liquidity is blocked), beforeSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta
No owner, not upgradeable, no custom hookData, no dynamic fee
Not audited. Tested on a Base mainnet fork.
Website: https://twigpine.com/ · Wrap page: https://wrap.twigpine.com/
